size_note: 150 x 46 x 34 mm (gsmchoice; the Siemens S4 it is built on: 150 x 45 x 28). A Siemens-made variant of the S4 with Sony's own front and a sliding earpiece. Shown open, the earpiece slid up. The museum's straight-on shots of the closed and open phone give the front face 3.42 times as long as wide closed: 43.9 x 150 mm (the 46 counts the side keys), and 162.2 mm open. The antenna stands 7.9 mm above the open earpiece (layout_mm.parts). No spec gives the display diagonal: the LCD measures about 32 x 18 mm; 1.25in at the native 97 x 33
